name: editorial

copywriting_tone.style: Refined, minimal, confident. Short sentences. Implication over explanation. Never sell too hard.

examples.hero_tagline: Crafted with precision. Built to endure.
examples.about_opener: Our work speaks quietly — in details that last and spaces that feel right.
examples.trust_language: By referral only. Portfolio available upon request.

layout_variant.hero_style: Asymmetric. Oversized Bodoni italic display type. Minimal CTA. Confident whitespace.
layout_variant.nav_style: Minimal. No phone in nav. Word-mark brand. Generous padding.
layout_variant.cta_style: Understated. Gold-on-dark. Longer, considered language. Never aggressive.
layout_variant.gallery_style: Asymmetric CSS grid. Full-bleed images. Intentional whitespace between frames.
layout_variant.review_style: Single featured quote. Large italic type. No star ratings.
layout_variant.spacing: Premium. 6–8rem section padding. Confident whitespace does the selling.
layout_variant.typography: Bodoni italic display. Wide tracking on uppercase labels. Light Space Grotesk body.

layout_notes: Asymmetric hero with large display type. Gallery drives first impression. Service list is typographic, not card-based. Slow pacing conveys prestige.
